best_for: People who already chat with Claude in the browser and want it in its own window on Windows or Mac, with a global shortcut, local file access and, on paid plans, Claude Code.

points.title: The app is free; heavy use is not
points.text: The Free plan works in the desktop app with usage limits that reset every 5 hours and weekly, and it does not include Opus. Pro is USD 17 per month billed yearly or USD 20 monthly; Max starts at USD 100 per month. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Claude Code needs a paid plan
points.text: Claude Code runs inside the desktop app, where you can preview a running server, review local code changes and follow pull requests. It is not part of Free; it starts with Pro.

points.title: More than a browser tab
points.text: Quick Entry opens Claude from anywhere with a hotkey. Desktop extensions let it read local files and work with other apps, and connectors reach web tools. Chats, projects and memory sync when you are signed in.

points.title: Cowork wants a strong machine
points.text: Cowork runs tasks in a virtual machine on your computer. Anthropic lists hardware virtualization, about 25 GB of free disk and at least 8 GB of RAM.

points.title: Requirements and updates
points.text: Anthropic lists macOS 13 Ventura or later and Windows 10 or later. The app updates itself on a release channel: Stable by default, or Latest, which updates about once a day. Switching back to Stable does not roll back your version.

points.title: Windows builds for x64 and Arm64
points.text: Windows comes as an MSIX package (Windows 10 build 19041 or later) or a per-user .exe, each for x64 and Arm64. The Windows listing keeps 176 versions; macOS lists only the current universal build, so a Mac downgrade needs another source.

points.title: Linux is a separate beta
points.text: Anthropic now has a Linux beta for Ubuntu 22.04 and Debian 12 or later, through its apt repository, but it is not listed here. On Linux, computer use and dictation are missing, and Claude Code and Cowork need Pro or higher.
